{{Quote|The [system] most fitting their needs is the Abraxas system.|[[Von Asch]]|<ref name="Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>}}
The '''Abraxas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and included the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Abraxas]] and [[Radix]]. The system, dubbed a "death trap" by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] associate, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kine (pirate)|Kine]], was cluttered with derelict spacecraft and abandoned orbital factories. Debris caught by the planetary gravity wells was flung about in a deadly dance which made navigating the system nearly impossible. Abraxas' space was prone to causing sensory rebounds and false readings, called "ghosts".
